description:
PostgreSQL instance trends and maintenance work.

Sections:
- Performance: Throughput and resource trends
- Maintenance: Vacuum, bloat, and capacity planning

panels.description: Combined commits and rollbacks per second.
panels.title: Transactions per second

panels.description: Queries per second. Requires pg_stat_statements extension.
panels.title: Queries per second

panels.description:
Rows fetched (sum): Number of rows fetched by queries per second.  

Rows inserted (sum): Number of rows inserted per second.  

Rows updated (sum): Number of rows updated per second.  

Rows deleted (sum): Number of rows deleted per second.
panels.title: Read/write ratio

panels.description: Read (fetched) and write (insert/update/delete) operations over time.
panels.title: Read/write over time

panels.description: Percentage of max_connections in use. Above 80% is warning, above 95% is critical.

targets.expr:
sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_activity_count{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
/
max by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (pg_settings_max_connections{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

)

panels.title: Connection utilization

panels.description: Buffer pool activity: allocations, cleaned by bgwriter, and max written stops (I/O pressure indicator).
panels.title: Buffers activity

panels.description: Cache hit ratio over time. Should stay above 95%.

targets.expr:
sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
  +
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

)

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Blocks read from disk (not cache). Spikes indicate cache misses.
panels.title: Disk reads

panels.description: Bytes written to temp files. High values indicate work_mem is too small.
panels.title: Temp bytes written

panels.description: Rate of new buffer allocations per second. High values indicate memory pressure.
panels.title: Buffers allocated

panels.description: Percentage of transactions rolled back. High values indicate application issues.

targets.expr:
avg by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
(
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_commit{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
  +
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

)

panels.title: Rollback ratio

panels.description: Ratio of tables with > 10% dead tuples. Run VACUUM on these tables.
panels.title: Tables needing vacuum ratio

panels.description: Time since oldest table was vacuumed. > 7 days is warning.
panels.title: Oldest vacuum age

panels.description: Dead tuple ratio per table. > 10% needs VACUUM.
panels.title: Dead tuple ratio

panels.description: Tables with dead tuple ratio and time since last vacuum. Sort by dead tuple ratio to find tables needing VACUUM.
panels.title: Table vacuum status

panels.description: Ratio of seq scans to total. High values indicate missing indexes.

targets.expr:
avg by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_user_tables_seq_scan{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
/
(
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_user_tables_seq_scan{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
  +
  sum by (job,postgres_cluster,cluster,instance) (pg_stat_user_tables_idx_scan{job=~"$job",postgres_cluster=~"$postgres_cluster",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})
  + 1
)

)

panels.title: Sequential scan ratio

panels.description: Indexes with zero scans. Candidates for removal.
panels.title: Unused indexes

panels.description: Indexes with zero buffer hits and disk reads since stats reset. Candidates for removal to save disk space.
panels.title: Unused indexes

panels.description: Time since oldest table was last analyzed. Stale stats can lead to poor query plans.
panels.title: Oldest analyze age

panels.description: Tables with time since last analyze. Stale statistics can cause poor query plans.
panels.title: Table analyze status

panels.title: Database size
